text: ok this is probably nothing and i feel kind of stupid messaging but minha mãe told me to text since she's driving back from work and can't. i'm looking after my baby sister, she's 7 months. she has a rash on her chest and back, little red blotchy bits, and when i pressed a glass on those like i saw online they went pale, desaparecem, so i thought ok fine. BUT then i saw some other spots on her legs that are different, like tiny dark red/purple dots, bem pequenininhos, and a couple bigger bits that look a bit like bruises. i did the glass thing on those too and they DIDN'T go away, you could still see them through the glass clearly. i tried it twice to make sure. não sei se é normal for babies or if i'm overthinking. my mum says she'll be home in about an hour but i didn't want to just sit here and wait if it's something. sorry if this is a dumb question, i don't really know what i'm looking at
